Checking Out The View From Mary Jane’s Hideaway
A Spectacular B And B And B Overlooking Vancouver
It’s A Tough Job, But Someone Has To Do It! Special To Marijuananews

September 24, 1999

Your intrepid reporter has ventured into the hills overlooking Vancouver. My friends at Blunt Bros. have what I call a B and B and B. A bed and bud and breakfast. Well, it is truly amazing.

It is in a huge house in the most exclusive neighborhood in North Vancouver. It has an indoor swimming pool, hot tub, sauna, pool table, pin ball machine, (a word of advice: don’t play against your host who practices a lot.)

Vancouver has one of the most spectacular natural settings of any major city. Mary Jane’s has an absolutely breathtaking view of it all.

Oh yes, the third "B?" The hospitality includes samples from the herb cabinet.

The only bad news is that there are only three suites and they are priced in line with the top Vancouver hotels, which offer fewer amenities. At US$200 to $250 per night this is not for everyone, but for anyone planning a deluxe vacation to Vansterdam, this is the place to stay. 

(If you can handle that, their number is 604-68BLUNT.)
